messages:
alex_product: FYI — Sales pegged a strategic account asking for reserved capacity + dynamic overage credits. They want tiered per-token pricing when committed GPU is full. Can product weigh in on feasibility and launch needs?

marta_sales: Customer is a fintech midmarket. Wants committed 4x A100 equivalent, plus ability to burst 2x on-demand. Main ask: when they burst, overage should consume 'credits' first (bought monthly), then charged at a lower overage per-token rate.

diego_support: Filed a support ticket with logs showing their peak patterns. They're sensitive to unpredictable bills; want cap/notification and a smoother billing signal.

sam_engineer: Technical constraints: we already do reserved + burst routing, but billing path currently does immediate per-token invoice for overage. Implementing credit-first consumption is straightforward in billing layer but we need clarity on reconciliation window and refunds. Also need to ensure telemetry marks which tokens used under credits for cost reporting.

naomi_product: Proposal for intake: (1) define product rule for credit pools attached to a reserved contract, (2) policy: exhaust credits before per-token billing, with a hard cap option, (3) UI: show live credit balance and expected burn rate. Need acceptance criteria and rollout plan.

alex_product: Acceptance criteria draft: - API/console shows credit pool balance and burn-rate estimate per minute; - Overages consume credit pool first; - Alerts when credits < 20% and when estimated monthly spend delta > 15%; - Billing statement separates committed, credit-consumed overage, and charged overage lines.

marta_sales: From GTM: prefer a predictable blended rate for committed+burst customers for sales conversations. If we can offer an optional 'blended overage bundle' that guarantees a single blended effective per-token price up to X% burst, that's marketable.

jordan_finance: Blended bundles require modeling risk. Need to know expected distribution: what % of customers would consistently burst? Also need clear accounting treatment for credits (prepaid liability).

sam_engineer: Implementation notes: schema changes in billing -> add credit_pool_id on request events. Router already tags requests as reserved vs burst. We need to surface credit_consumed boolean and amount in traces. ETA: ~3 sprints to land end-to-end (router tag, billing apply, UI).

naomi_product: Scope negotiation: MVP should be credit-pool + credit-first consumption + minimal UI (balance + usage). Post-MVP: blended-bundle product and canary pricing UI with forecast charts. Decide whether blended bundle is GA or opt-in pilot.

diego_support: For rollout, we need two things in support runbook: how to troubleshoot credit mismatches, and how to handle mid-cycle credit top-ups.

alex_product: Risks: - Complexity in invoicing and finance reconciliation, - Customer confusion if credits and charged overage appear on same invoice line, - Abuse where credits used for test workloads. Mitigation: caps, rounding rules, and default alerting.

naomi_product: Launch criteria candidate checklist: 1) End-to-end e2e test with simulated burst trace; 2) Billing report verifies correct allocation in 3 sample customers; 3) UX shows balance and top-up flow; 4) Support/doc runbook published; 5) Legal sign-off on T&Cs for prepaid credits.

marta_sales: Can we fast-track a pilot with the asking customer? They'll agree to be pilot if we offer a 60-day grace period and a dedicated CSM.

jordan_finance: Pilot ok but require pilot contract with explicit liability cap and reporting cadence. Finance will prepare reconciliation template.

sam_engineer: If agreed, we can scope a pilot branch: the critical path is billing logic + UI hook. Estimate 6 weeks for pilot MVP if we prioritize.

deploy-bot: deploy:billing-service v2.14.1 promoted to staging @1765432250

alex_product: Action items: (A) Product to add intake ticket (priority P1) with naive acceptance criteria (naomi) and pilot ask; (B) Engineering to confirm sprint allocation and provide estimate; (C) Finance to draft pilot reconciliation template; (D) Sales to prepare pilot contract language. Assign owners and sync end of week.

naomi_product: Adding to backlog now with labels: pricing, pilot, reserved-capacity. I'll ping eng for estimate and schedule a 30-min sync.

marta_sales: Thanks — I'll prep the customer's pilot acceptance and send sample usage CSV.

jordan_finance: I'll circulate reconciliation template by EOD Friday.

alex_product: Great. Closing thread for now; we'll follow up in the intake ticket. :thumbsup:
